title: Research on the migration and transformation patterns of volatile pyrolysis products of WPCB by an online pyrolysis-mass spectrometry method
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,39417-39430
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06737E, Paper
Open Access

Meng Tian, Zihe Liu, Dongyin Ren, Xianglan Zhang, Cai Tie
Online pyrolysis-MS reveals that Br and Cl release from PL-WCCL occurs in two stages (233–330 °C, 470–520 °C), whereas in FR4-WPCB, their release is largely completed between 300–400 °C.
